messages.author: f12768d4e6e83192
messages.subject: Exploratory Data Analysis using Rattle
parts:
Hi All,

I have a data set that consists of remote sensing spectral data and
associated lidar metrics. The spectral data consists of 4m resolution
blue, green, red, and near-IR spectra, while the lidar data consists
of various lidar metrics derived from a top of canopy point cloud. My
aim is to explore what relationships exist between the spectral data
and the lidar metrics and use these relationships in further analysis.
The idea behind the project is to develop an optimal lidar sampling
scheme for forest structural assessment.

What are your thoughts on the matter and do you think that Rattle is
suitable for exploratory data analysis. If not could you point me
towards a suitable replacement.

Many thanks and kind regards,
Wesley

Hi Wesley,

I dealt with the same problem before though i did not use Rattle. I used modelling techniques such as GLM, GAM and ordinary least squares regression in R in correlating different vegetion indices derived from RS with environmental or species variables. You can try it.

Good luck and best regards.

Dante
